units.source_text: 冷泉院对玉鬘夫人的恋情，至今犹未断绝。

en.t: Reizei-in's love for Lady Tamakazura had still not come to an end.

units.source_text: 因此即使有重要事情，玉鬘夫人也不入院。

en.t: For that reason, even when there was something important to attend to, Lady Tamakazura did not go to the Retired Emperor's residence.

units.source_text: 但她回想过去坚拒他的求爱，觉得对他不起，至今犹感抱歉。

en.t: Yet when she thought back on how firmly she had rejected his courtship in the past, she felt she had wronged him and was still sorry even now.

units.source_text: 因此人皆不赞许她送大女公子入院，她只当作不知，管自独断独行。

en.t: So although everyone disapproved of her sending her eldest daughter to Reizei-in, she pretended not to notice and went ahead on her own judgment.

units.source_text: 但念如果连她自己都犯了嫌疑，流传了轻薄之名，那真是太不成样子了。

en.t: But she thought that if even she herself fell under suspicion and gained a reputation for frivolity, it would be truly disgraceful.

units.source_text: 然而未便向新皇妃明言：由于这点顾忌，所以不去望她。

en.t: Still, she could not plainly tell the new imperial consort that this concern was the reason she did not visit her.

units.source_text: 新皇妃便怨恨母亲，她想：

en.t: The new imperial consort therefore resented her mother and thought:
From childhood, I was especially loved by my father.

units.source_text: 母亲则处处袒护妹妹，像争夺樱花树等小小事情，也都如此。

en.t: Mother, however, always took my younger sister's side, even in small matters like fighting over the cherry tree.

units.source_text: 直到现在，母亲还是不喜欢我的。”

en.t: Even now, Mother still does not like me.

units.source_text: 冷泉院更是怪怨玉鬘夫人冷淡，常有不平之言。

en.t: Reizei-in, for his part, blamed Lady Tamakazura all the more for her coldness and often voiced his dissatisfaction.
He said warmly to the new imperial consort:

units.source_text: “你母亲把你推给了我这老头子，从此就不理睬我们，这原是理所当然的事。”

en.t: Your mother pushed you onto this old man, and since then she has paid no attention to either of us; that is only natural.

units.source_text: 便更加宠爱这新皇妃了。

en.t: And so he cherished the new imperial consort even more.
